title: Grafana Alert Alert Value Leaderboard
dataSources: Proxmox node/VM metrics (`proxmox:metric`), Docker container stats (`docker:stats`), Synology/TrueNAS (`synology:disk`, `truenas:pool`), Raspberry Pi host metrics, UPS status via NUT (`nut:ups`).
app: Proxmox / Docker / Portainer, Synology/TrueNAS, Raspberry Pi, and UPS (NUT) metrics via the Splunk Universal Forwarder, collectd/telegraf, and HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=grafana:alert value_num=*
| stats sum(value_num) as total_value, avg(value_num) as avg_value by alertname
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks alert values by total and average alert value across Grafana alert events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `value_num` values for each Grafana alert event and review total and average alert value by alert.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total alert value.
grandmaExplanation: It reviews which alert shows the biggest alert value numbers in your Grafana alert data.
